scope: Independent design review of the private-checkout Expo entry topology correction; no private checkout, runtime, Metro, simulator, account, storage, build, or install action.

repositoryEvidence.physicalResolution: The installed Expo entry realpath is in the main repository; its relative App resolution targets the main repository App, not a detached private checkout.
repositoryEvidence.interpretation: This supports a concrete wrong-entry ownership risk. It does not establish that this caused the prior Profile Storage gate.

assessment.topology: A private node_modules directory with existing root package entries linked and Expo copied byte-for-byte preserves installed dependency versions while causing Expo AppEntry's relative App import to resolve within the private checkout.
assessment.sourceBinding: The source binding does not bind node_modules topology. Keep the existing executed binding/receipt immutable, issue a fresh old-ref source-only binding/nonce from a clean exact-ref copy, and separately record the private topology and exact Expo copy digest. Retain the unused new-ref binding only if its existing exact source/tool/patch guards pass.
assessment.gateAndDataSafety: Require private application module ownership, normal published storage, and exact selected-account baseline before session-changing UI. If storage remains unavailable or the baseline differs, stop without retry, repair, bypass, bootstrap, or Q13 session creation.
assessment.scope: No product source, package.json, native settings, shared dependency, credential, or storage change is justified.

conditionsBeforeExecution: Verify the private node_modules symlink target before replacing only that owned checkout entry; do not alter the main repository node_modules or shared package contents.
Verify every copied Expo package byte against the installed source and record its private digest and package-entry/link topology.
Prove expo/AppEntry resolves to the exact private checkout App.tsx before starting Metro.
During a read-only app startup, require the loaded application module tree to be private-checkout-owned with no main-repository App/application modules; do not infer this from the planned topology.
Compare the selected account's fresh baseline before any Q13 session mutation; stop on an unavailable gate or any unexplained difference.
verificationPerformed: Resolved installed AppEntry realpath and relative ../../App target.
Read the accepted Debug/Metro revision and the dependency-topology proposal.
notPerformed: No private checkout or node_modules symlink was inspected or changed.
No Metro process, simulator, app, account, storage, build, or install action was performed.
No claim that the prior Profile Storage gate is fixed or causally explained.

preparationHelperSourceReview.normalMutationScope: The helper removes only repo/node_modules when that symlink resolves exactly to the supplied root node_modules, creates a private node_modules directory, links all existing root package entries except expo, copies Expo with symlinks preserved, verifies the source/copy tree digest, and checks the physical AppEntry relative App.tsx resolution. It invokes no package manager and changes no shared package contents.
preparationHelperSourceReview.staticCheck: Python AST parse passed on the corrected source; reviewer did not execute the mutating helper.
preparationHelperSourceReview.correctedGuards: Current source uses explicit RuntimeError guards rather than assert and resolves the output path before restricting it to /private/tmp. Root reports a python3 -O escaped-output probe failed before mutation.
preparationHelperSourceReview.residualScopeLimit: The canonical repo path uses a fixed prefix rather than enumerated exact checkout roots. Mutation still targets only that supplied private checkout's node_modules, and only unlinks it if the target resolves exactly to the supplied root dependencies.
preparationHelperSourceReview.currentRunDisposition: Root reports prior calls used plain python3 with exact private absolute args and produced passing Expo tree/AppEntry receipts; PYTHONOPTIMIZE was absent. Root also reports rechecking both physical AppEntry/App resolutions and symlink targets. Reviewer could not inspect private artifacts or independently run these checks.
preparationHelperSourceReview.noRuntimeClaim: No Metro listener on port 8081 is parent-reported; no Q13 runtime result is claimed.
